Select compounds reported in the specified document. Join docs by chembl_id, then compound_records on doc_id, then molecule_dictionary on molregno, then compound_structures on molregno. Filter docs.chembl_id to the value CHEMBL1129278. Return molecule_chembl_id, pref_name as molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id ascending.
